descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A2 · P2 · 无障碍

状态和错误不播报：报错、无搜索结果、Ask AI 的回答、「Listening…」都不读出来；开关没有选中 / 按下状态

票：TFA-94745 等 · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：EFS/S22, OAT-03/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-23/S18, TC-09/S23

思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S19 「视觉车道里的 Ask 面板：axe（WCAG 2 A/AA）、手机宽度和 WebKit，两种模式」 Ask sheet in the visual lane: axe (WCAG 2 A/AA), phone width and WebKit, both contexts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T2 Ask About This Patient is reachable from all three tabs (Pre-Round, Encounter, Post-Round).（TFA-92593 AC 2）
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3).（UAT 3.3；TFA-92593 AC 9）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Ask sheet open on Pre-Round, Encounter and Post-Round in both contexts, and once with an answer shown; desktop Chrome, Pixel 7, iPhone 15 (WebKit)

When Run axe and the overflow / tap-target checks on each open sheet

Then Presets, input, Dictate and Ask buttons have accessible names; the answer region is announced; nothing off-screen at 390 px

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Visual-lane findings are evidence for a person to review (serious/critical axe violations and off-screen elements listed), not Pass/Fail. The iOS keyboard covering the input is a device check (S20)

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 passed 改成 failed。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92593 ready for qa

读屏用户在 Ask AI 提问后，答案出来时不会被播报（答案区不是 live region）；面板的关闭 X 也没有名字。

A screen-reader user who asks Ask AI a question is not told when the answer arrives, because the answer is not in a live region, and the sheet's close X has no name.

依据：Allure ca1eefa1. Visual lane, record-only (46 checks held, 6 did not). The answer in src/components/AskModal.tsx is not in an aria-live region, and the close X is unnamed. Not in the dev report or ledger.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-15 Ask AI · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-15/S19

Ask sheet in the visual lane: axe (WCAG 2 A/AA), phone width and WebKit, both contexts

Tickets: TFA-92593 Ask AI (ready for qa)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status record-only → 通过（只记录（判过的都通过；带一个待定的产品问题，写在说明里））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：encounter.spec.ts: Ask sheet opened on Pre-Round, Encounter and Post-Round (both contexts) and once with a mocked askChart answer; names of presets/input/Dictate/Ask, answer in a live region, nothing off-screen sideways on phones; axe recorded for a person (oracle). [2026-10-14 review] Record-only: the oracle says 'evidence for a person … not Pass/Fail'; the same checks run as unjudged then-clause values; the missing live region on the answer is routed as a product issue. — The iOS keyboard covering the input is a device check (S20).

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: record-only (oracle: visual-lane findings are evidence for a person, not Pass/Fail). Then-clause checks evaluated, not judged: 46 held, 6 did not. Record-only per the oracle ('evidence for a person … not Pass/Fail'). Then-clause checks (not judged): presets, input, Dictate and Ask AI have names (the input only via its placeholder; the close X has none — recorded); nothing in the sheet is off-screen at phone width; axe recorded for a person.

产品问题：Routed for a person (record-only): the answer that appears after 'Ask AI' is not in a live region (src/components/AskModal.tsx), so a screen-reader user who asks a question is not told the answer arrived (then: 'the answer region is announced').

证据：附了 7 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-15_S19 — 目录（51 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), which refuses dev, and the answer state needs a mocked askChart reply (fault-ai), which dev has no mock for; so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
